thread:
Ava: Heads-up — I want to enable a compliance audit mode that turns on PII request logging for a short canary. Flag name: `REDWOOD_PII_LOG_AUDIT_MODE`. Goal is to verify detection+KMS routing before any retention change.
Carlos: 👍 who’s owning the guardrails (KMS/HSM path, retention off by default, RBAC)?
Ava: Carlos can own security checks. Riley can own infra rollout. Samir: I’ll own product-side scope (only internal test org + a few enterprise pilots).
Riley: For infra: canary to 2% initially, only requests from org IDs in `pii-audit-canary` allowlist. Autoscale OK.
Carlos: Must require `audit_storage=kms` or `audit_storage=hsm`. If storage is not set, flag should not be allowed ON — add validation. Also ensure no logs persist beyond 7d unless explicit retention=true and approved by legal.
Samir: We should exclude support logs and developer sessions. Also no export to third-party analytics while audit on.
Ava: Agreed. Quick checklist: 1) Feature flag gating + allowlist 2) KMS/HSM path presence validation 3) retention default OFF / 7d cap 4) telemetry to `audit-bucket` in secure project 5) PR + code review 6) scheduled canary window
Riley: infra side items: deploy toggle via `rgctl` and toggle gating in the proxy. I’ll add a pre-check that validates KMS key ARN: `arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/abcd`. If missing, the rollout fails.
Ava: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/feature-flags/pull/842 (do not merge until security sign-off).
Carlos: I’ll review now. Look for these tests: - unit to fail if KMS not set - integration that writes to `audit-bucket` with encryption - e2e that ensures allowlist only sees changes.
Samir: For canary audience: add 3 internal orgs + 1 enterprise pilot (acme-corp). Can we map those org IDs to env var `PII_AUDIT_CANARY_ORGS`?
Riley: yes. Will wire `PII_AUDIT_CANARY_ORGS` to feature-check. Also will add metric `pii_audit.error_rate` and alert if >0.5% error or any data leak paths detected.
Ava: Rollout schedule: Tue 09:00 UTC — canary 2% for 4h, then 10% for 6h if no alerts, then full internal for 24h. No external customer traffic without SOC sign-off.
Carlos: Add audit trails: who toggled flag, timestamp, and KMS key used. Those should go into `audit-log` with HSM-backed signing.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: feature flag `REDWOOD_PII_LOG_AUDIT_MODE` created in staging at 1715389200 by Riley.
audit-bot: audit-check: KMS key present, retention_policy=disabled, allowlist size=4.
Riley: I pushed a small patch to proxy: `if (!kmsKey) throw new Error('KMS required for PII audit')` — will add tests.
Carlos: After my review, we should do a security smoke: run `pii-scan` against canary logs to ensure no retention leak. I’ll schedule it.
Samir: Who does the rollback if something odd? Ops oncall + Riley. Command: `rgctl feature toggle off REDWOOD_PII_LOG_AUDIT_MODE --reason "incident"`
Ava: Ping for reviews: @Carlos @Riley @Samir — please comment on the PR by EOD. If all clear, enable canary Tue 09:00 UTC.
Carlos: Reviewing now. Quick note: ensure legal sign-off for retention policy overrides.
Riley: Will add health checks and circuit breaker (auto-off if `pii_audit.error_rate` > 0.5%).
Ava: Perfect. Post-rollout, we’ll run a 24h compliance review and produce an artifact for audits.
Samir: Confirmed. I’ll update the customer pilot docs and internal runbook.
Carlos: :thumbsup:
Ava: Thanks team — adding a quick checklist to the PR description.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled canary for 1715533200 (Tue 09:00 UTC).
Riley: tagging oncall for Tue window: @oncall-ops.
Ava: End of thread — will post a summary in #product after rollout.
